import urllib.request
import json
import urllib.parse
import re

def yt_search(query):
    url = 'https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=' + urllib.parse.quote(query)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/115.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'})
    html = urllib.request.urlopen(req).read().decode('utf-8')
    # find ytInitialData
    m = re.search(r'var ytInitialData = ({.*?});</script>', html)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'window\[\"ytInitialData\"\] = ({.*?});</script>', html)
    if m:
        data = json.loads(m.group(1))
        # traverse
        videos = []
        def extract(obj):
            if isinstance(obj, dict):
                if 'videoRenderer' in obj:
                    vr = obj['videoRenderer']
                    title = vr.get('title', {}).get('runs', [{}])[0].get('text')
                    vid = vr.get('videoId')
                    desc = vr.get('detailedMetadataSnippets', [{}])[0].get('snippetText', {}).get('runs', [{}])[0].get('text') if vr.get('detailedMetadataSnippets') else None
                    published = vr.get('publishedTimeText', {}).get('simpleText')
                    videos.append((vid, title, published))
                for k, v in obj.items():
                    extract(v)
            elif isinstance(obj, list):
                for item in obj:
                    extract(item)
        extract(data)
        return videos
    else:
        print('No ytInitialData found')
        return []

for q in ['\"Andy Serkis\" \"360\"', '\"Andy Serkis\" \"VR\"', '\"Andy Serkis\" 360 VR']:
    print('Query:', q)
    vids = yt_search(q)
    for v in vids[:5]:
        print(v)

def gh_search(query):
    # github api without auth requires user-agent
    req = urllib.request.Request('https://api.github.com/search/code?q=' + urllib.parse.quote(query), headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})

        data = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).read().decode())

        print('GH err:', e)

import urllib.request
import json
import urllib.parse

def wp_search(query):
    url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=search&srsearch=' + urllib.parse.quote(query) + '&format=json'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'ResearchBot/1.0 (contact@example.com)'})
    try:
        data = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).read().decode())
        for item in data.get('query', {}).get('search', []):
            print(item['title'], ':', item['snippet'])
    except Exception as e:
        print('WP err:', e)

wp_search('\"We Are Stars\"')
